turnout.notes: Kansas turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout artifact is collected.

reviewCharts.warning: Kansas review rows use official Kansas Secretary of State precinct presidential rows and President-versus-U.S.-House same-row comparisons. The U.S. House workbook stores Johnson, Sedgwick, Shawnee, and Wyandotte in separate wide-format tabs; three nonzero presidential local rows do not have a matching House comparison and are kept as vote-share-only rows. U.S. House is district-based, so these are advisory screening inputs, not confirmed findings.

historicalBaselines.warning: Kansas historical baseline rows are county-level context for 2012, 2016, and 2020. 2020 rows are normalized from official Kansas Secretary of State presidential workbooks and certified PDF totals. 2016 rows use the official SOS presidential workbook for 101 counties plus secondary contextual county rows for Johnson, Sedgwick, Shawnee, and Wyandotte because those counties are absent from the workbook; statewide totals reconcile to the official 2016 PDF. The official 2012 SOS PDF did not expose county presidential rows in this pass, so 2012 county rows use secondary contextual tables and do not reconcile to the SOS statewide certified total. Use all historical rows as contextual baselines only, not as 2024 certified data.
